what: A matched-seed Sol-on / Sol-off pair on the night-market t2va scene, recorded because it is the cleanest controlled pair this repo has and it existed only as two files that looked good.
recorded_by: bench/diff_render_graphs.py --diff, against the graphs ComfyUI embedded in the two renders

renders.location: the share's ComfyUI output directory; see start.sh --output-directory

the_only_difference.everything_else: identical, verified field by field on the reachable graph; prompt sha256[:16] 9a611ee9f0ee7265 in both, 2347 chars

shared_configuration.sigmas_source: MiniMaxH3PDDLoRA SIGMAS output, slot 1, through a VisualizeSigmasKJ passthrough
shared_configuration.no_model_sampling_shift_node: removed; a no-op here, since supported_models.py MiniMaxH3 already carries shift 12.0 / audio_shift 3.0 and the node's defaults are the same two numbers

derived.pdd_head_coverage: block_w 4 over the 32-point grid; the 8 evaluations tile heads [0,4) [4,8) ... [28,32) exactly. 32 of 32 heads, no duplicates, no gaps.
derived.sol_active_steps: 4 of 8. percent_to_sigma at shift 12 puts the window at sigma in (0.808290, 0.979592]; steps 3-6 fall inside, steps 1-2 are above it and 7-8 below.
derived.near_boundary: step 7 at sigma 0.8 misses the window by 0.008. end_percent 0.75 is the exact boundary that would include it.

what_this_establishes: Both arms met the brief. Sol at these settings did not break this scene.
what_this_does_not_establish: Nothing about which arm is better. Sol is a numerical change to attention, so the trajectory diverges from frame 0 and the two clips are different samples rather than one sample with and without Sol -- the standing rule in CLAUDE.md. dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu compounds it: it injects noise every step, so two runs of the same arm would also differ. n=1, not blinded, not scored under docs/eval_comparison.md section 3.
owner_note: The owner recalled the two renders also differing in prompt, length and resolution. The embedded graphs do not show that -- all three are identical. Either a different pair of files was meant, or the recollection is of the deviation from the repo's h3_text_to_video_churn_long workflow, which does differ in all three.
